mongolia.title: A land of natural wonders and cultural heritage
mongolia.lead: Mongolia, the cradle of nomadic civilization, is a land of extraordinary natural beauty.
body: The majestic Altai and Khangai mountain ranges, the pristine landscapes of Lake Khovsgol and the vast Gobi Desert together create a breathtaking panorama of steppe, lakes and dramatic rock formations.

Traveling through Mongolia offers a unique opportunity to connect with nature, discover inner peace and experience the rich traditions of nomadic culture. We invite you to explore Mongolia's remarkable landscapes and its distinctive cultural heritage through our carefully designed travel experiences.
highlights: The majestic Altai and Khangai ranges
The pristine shores of Lake Khovsgol
The vast Gobi Desert and its rock formations
mongolia.alt: A green valley in Gorkhi-Terelj National Park
mongolia.altInset: White gers lined up on the open steppe

naadam.title: The Naadam Festival
naadam.lead: Held every July, Naadam is Mongolia's most celebrated national festival.
body: It showcases the strength, skill and endurance of the Mongolian people through the traditional Three Manly Games: wrestling, horse racing and archery. Powerful wrestlers compete in the arena, swift horses race across the open steppe, and skilled archers demonstrate their remarkable precision.

The festival is not only a sporting event but a vibrant expression of Mongolia's cultural heritage. Visitors can experience traditional games, music and dance performances, taste authentic Mongolian cuisine, wear a traditional deel for memorable photos, and immerse themselves in a festive atmosphere that is truly unique in the world.
naadam.alt: Riders and spectators at the Naadam horse race
naadam.altInset: Wrestlers grappling on the Naadam field

enduro.title: Enduro & moto tours
enduro.lead: An adventure filled with adrenaline across Mongolia's vast steppe and unique landscapes.
body: Riding a motorcycle here not only enhances balance and concentration, it also brings a powerful sense of freedom as you race against the wind — a refreshing escape and a natural way to release stress.
Discover the true thrill of speed, strength, endurance and courage as you ride through the boundless Mongolian steppe: an unforgettable adventure unlike anywhere else in the world.
enduro.alt: An open road running toward the mountains of Bayan-Olgii
enduro.altInset: A herder on a motorcycle driving his flock across the steppe

snowLeopard.title: Snow leopard tour — where nature and culture meet
snowLeopard.lead: Khovd Province is one of the most remarkable travel destinations in western Mongolia.
body: Surrounded by towering mountains, crystal-clear lakes and vast open landscapes, this region brings pristine nature, rich nomadic culture and adventure travel together. Within the rugged cliffs and high peaks of the Altai live some of the world's rarest wildlife, including the elusive snow leopard, argali sheep and Siberian ibex, while golden eagles soar high across the skies.

Khovd is also one of the most ethnically diverse regions of Mongolia. The Zakhchin, Dorvod, Uriankhai, Torguud, Myangad, Oold and Kazakh peoples all continue to preserve their unique traditions and lifestyles. Travelers have the opportunity to experience authentic nomadic life, taste traditional cuisine, enjoy local music and witness centuries-old cultural customs.

The region is home to breathtaking natural attractions, including Khar Us Lake National Park, the dramatic Altai mountain ranges and the ancient rock paintings of Khoid Tsenkher Cave. Together with its untouched steppe, these wonders make Khovd a captivating destination for travelers seeking both natural beauty and cultural discovery.
highlights: Snow leopard, argali, ibex and golden eagle
Seven ethnic groups and their living traditions
Khar Us Lake National Park and Khoid Tsenkher Cave
snowLeopard.alt: A wild snow leopard on a rocky Mongolian ridge
snowLeopard.altInset: Kazakh eagle hunters on horseback before the Altai mountains

fishing.title: Fishing in the Khentii taiga
fishing.lead: Batshireet, in the north-east of the Khentii range, is one of Mongolia's most beautiful taiga regions.
body: The area lies within the Onon-Balj National Park and the basin of the Onon river, and is known for untouched wilderness: clear rivers, dense taiga forest and wide open valleys.

Its pristine taiga and clear water hold Mongolia's great freshwater fish — taimen, lenok, grayling and pike. Combined with rare wildlife and wild berries, this makes Batshireet an ideal region for sport fishing and nature-focused travel.
highlights: Clear rivers and untouched taiga forest

how.intro: We handle the planning, the visas, the tickets and the beds. You are left with the journey itself.

brief.title: Tell us what you want
brief.body: Two minutes, a couple of questions. What you are drawn to and where you want to go — that is all we need to start.

shape.title: We shape the programme
shape.body: A real planner builds the route, books the stays and tickets, and briefs the guides who live there. If you need a visa, we prepare the documents with you.

go.body: Transport, meals and accommodation all sit in one programme. You only have to bring your bag.
